meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 用户给它一段“有人出镜说话”的本地视频(访谈/播客),它会先转录语音,再把设计好的图文卡片(开场大标题、底部信息条、引言等)按对应时间叠到画面,最后输出 MP4;原视频本身不改动。
howto.when: 当用户拿现成“人物出镜”视频(采访/播客)来,要求叠“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”这类图形卡,或说“包装/装饰视频”时触发;纯字幕不归它,拿不准先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这段访谈视频加上开场标题和底部信息条,按说话时间出现。
say.note: 会先转录,再按对应时间渲染并输出 MP4。

say.text: 把这段播客做成 9:16 竖版,配上数据卡片和画中画。
say.note: 画面按竖版尺寸排布,叠加层与内容同步。

say.text: 这是一段10分钟讲解视频,挑几句金句做成引言卡。
say.note: 会从转录里挑句子作为引文卡,覆盖到画面上。

howto.what_en: Given an existing interview/talking-head video, Claude transcribes the speech, designs timed overlay cards (opening title, lower-thirds, quotes), and renders an MP4; the original clip plays unchanged underneath.
howto.when_en: Trigger when keywords like "graphic overlays" or "on-screen graphics" appear, or when the user asks to package/dress up an existing talking-head video; plain subtitles are excluded and unclear intents route via /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add an opening title and lower-thirds to this interview video, timed to what is said.
say_en.note: It transcribes first, times each card, then renders the MP4.

say_en.text: Make a 9:16 cut of this podcast with data cards and PiP.
say_en.note: Uses a portrait canvas and renders the vertical composition.

say_en.text: This is a 10-min explainer; pull key lines into quote overlay cards.
say_en.note: Memorable lines become quote graphics laid over the video.
